title: xpsloss: dielectric-response electron energy losses in XPS
description:
xpsloss is an independent Python library and command-line tool that implements published dielectric-response models of electron energy loss in X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS). Version 0.2.0 covers oscillator energy-loss functions, bulk differential inverse inelastic mean free paths, causal dielectric response including hard gaps, the fixed-depth XPS effective cross section of Simonsen, Yubero and Tougaard (1997), Eqs. (13)-(17), for normal emission from a positive depth in gapless materials and in accepted materials with a hard band gap, and its depth average with the single-scattering path weight of Eq. (18) and an externally supplied constant length.

Scope and limits are stated in the repository: the two momentum choices are verified differently; one planned independent check of the depth average (route I3, k_parallel) was not run and another is incomplete; the comparison with QUEELS-XPS v2.1 is limited to the tested inputs; there is no comparison with measured spectra and no human peer review. xpsloss is not an official, endorsed or compatibility-guaranteed version of QUEELS-XPS.
